consolidation.feature_budget_rationale: The 25% CA-2 outcome was measured at merge. Post-merge features may add up to 500 source lines without silently abandoning the reduction; VD-4 formatter normalization adds a one-time, measured 855-line allowance for physical lines introduced by canonical `ruff format` wrapping, not feature headroom. The owner approved an allowance of up to 900 lines; the exact measured delta is recorded. ADR 0011 records a separate, one-time 565-line allowance for the owner-approved bounded-evidence-waiver feature; the measured feature delta after review fixes is 709 lines; the 565-line waiver allowance plus all 144 lines of prior headroom were used, leaving no headroom. The follow-on execution-failure target kind adds a further explicit, one-time 107-line allowance recorded in the ADR 0011 addendum; that measured delta is not general feature headroom and does not renew the 500-line budget. The multi-row execution-reason refinement adds a further explicit, one-time 11-line allowance; only allowlisted exact reason codes may cover all matching required rows, with every row recorded. The effective ceiling is base*(1-required)+feature budget+formatting allowance+waiver feature allowance+execution-failure allowance+execution-reason allowance and is checked by tests/test_surface_consolidation.py.
